verdict.rationale: The first-party API reference documents a versioned public REST API (v3.6, with a v2 migration guide). It covers OAuth client-credentials and token auth across sandbox and live, and a scriptable backend flow: create applicant, create workflow run, then retrieve results via webhook or polling. Webhooks come with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and a live llms.txt probe confirms the docs present it as an API platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, and evidence of a machine-readable spec (e.g. OpenAPI) or official client libraries.
